description: This file defines classes and structures for a downlink baseband processor implementation in a software radio system, including configuration parameters, buffer management, and processing interfaces.

classes.name: baseband_symbol_buffer
classes.description: A buffer class for storing and reading OFDM symbol samples, supporting read/write operations and sample availability queries.

classes.name: downlink_processor_baseband_impl
classes.description: A class implementing a software-based downlink baseband processor, managing configuration, buffers, and processing logic.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the symbol buffer, marking it as empty.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads samples from the buffer starting at a given timestamp into an output buffer.

methods.name: write_symbol
methods.description: Provides write access to the buffer for a new symbol, setting its timestamp and size.

methods.name: get_nof_available_samples
methods.description: Returns the number of samples available for reading starting at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the processor to a notifier.

methods.name: get_cfo_control
methods.description: Returns the CFO processor control interface.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the current state at a given timestamp, implementing the main processing logic.

methods.name: set_tx_time_offset
methods.description: Sets the transmission time offset in samples.
